propositions: Jira-specific lazy-load literal keys are hardcoded in backend-neutral core modules (outbound_comments.py:68,71 and inbound_translate.py:315), causing Jira ADF encoding and comment limits to apply unconditionally for any configured backend.

The two literals must be eliminated by routing comment-fit and rich-text-decode responsibilities through port roles (FieldSanitizer.fit_comment and InboundMapper.normalize_rich_text) that are backend-agnostic.

Public inbound function _normalize_adf_body must remain importable and callable from apply_inbound_records.py but internally re-route through the backend's InboundMapper to preserve the bug-1bb2-5da5 defense (raw ADF dict never reaches EDIT event description).

A sweep test must verify no package-root core module contains the literal string 'rebar_reconciler.adapters.jira' except for the recorded exemption at inbound_fields.py:24 (the Jira InboundMapper implementation).
